name: Image-Based Localization (Floc)
definition: Finds the grid cell in the RNR-Map closest to a target image $I_{trg}$ by comparing latent codes, outputting a heatmap $E$ and predicted orientation $a_{trg}$.
summary: Image-Based Localization determines an agent's position in a Renderable Neural Radiance Map using a query image and latent codes, bypassing expensive rendering to output a spatial heatmap and orientation.
